summary: Scans the byte string at a1 for a NUL terminator, reading at most a2 bytes. Returns the string length (pointer difference) when a terminator is found, or the cap a2 cast to a pointer when the scan exhausts the cap without a NUL. On-frame-path bounded string-length helper.

operations.description: If the cap a2 is zero, skip the scan loop entirely.
Scan up to a2 bytes from a1 for a NUL terminator, breaking on NUL or when the cap is exhausted (countdown v3 seeded from a2 - 1).
If a NUL terminator was found, return the string length (v2 - a1).
If the scan reached the cap without a NUL (term at *v2 nonzero), return the cap value a2 cast to a pointer.
